stateVersion.description: Frozen Alpha UX state-machine contract version. Readers must fail closed on any other value (no best-effort reads); additive evolution follows the document-model discipline (ADR-0010) with a new schema file per version.

states.description: Exactly the 12 rows of docs/ux-spec.md §4, in table order. Enumeration boundary dual source (owner correction 2026-08-01): 7 rows map to the roadmap A-01 completion-evidence categories (loading/partial-success/failure/cancel/offline/recovery), 4 rows bind via ux-spec §4 '必须呈现', save-result is dual.

uxState.title: UxState
uxState.description: Conditional extension presence (pagination/permission/offline/recovery required by state id) is enforced by the code semantic layer in src/index.ts (UX_STATE_EXTENSION_MISSING), not by if/then here: json-schema-to-typescript degrades allOf-if/then to an untyped record, which would rob the 12 consumers of typed access.

id.description: Stable machine id; the importable contract handle for the 12 downstream consumers.

uxSpecRow.description: 1-based row number in docs/ux-spec.md §4; traceability anchor.

evidenceSource.description: Why this row is mandatory: roadmap A-01 completion evidence (loading/partial-success/failure/cancel/offline/recovery), ux-spec §4 '必须呈现', or dual (save-result: failure side from the roadmap, success side from ux-spec §4).

requiredPresentation.description: Verbatim from the ux-spec §4 '必须呈现' cell; every entry must have a visible rendering in any consuming UI.

forbiddenSemantics.description: Verbatim '不得' clauses from ux-spec §4/§5/§6/§7; states must not lie (no blank meaningless editor, no swallowing partial results, unaccepted AI output never touches formal content, failed save never pretends saved, no retry-loop dialogs).

transitions.description: Allowed successor state ids; semantic validation requires the graph to be closed (no dangling targets).

textEquivalent.description: Every state has a text equivalent expression (docs/accessibility.md); established at the state-machine level, not deferred to A-13.

focusEntry.description: Keyboard focus entry point for this state (keyboard reachable, focus visible).

noColorOnly.description: Errors and progress must not rely on color alone.

phase.description: Current pagination phase shown to the user.

stalePreviewRetained.description: The previous preview stays valid and visible until the new result is ready (ux-spec §4).

repaginationScope.description: D3 (ADR-0014): PoC-A full repagination is DEGRADE/not_met (PA-13 p95 24.3s vs 8s budget); the frozen state machine models INCREMENTAL pagination only and leaves the implementation slot for A-04. A full-repagination field is contract-level forbidden.

updatedPageRange.description: Optional: which pages were incrementally updated; partial updates keep the stale preview valid.

availableActions.description: What the user can still do right now (maps to PB-10 HOST_PERMISSION_DENIED degradation).

degradationOptions.description: Explicit degradation enumeration, e.g. continue without grant / export to an already-authorized location.

localCapabilitiesIntact.description: Local editing, pagination, checks and export stay fully usable while the model is unavailable (ux-spec §4/§5); AI degradation is implemented in A-07P, only the state is frozen here.

checkpoint.description: Which checkpoint the recovery restores to (PB-12 measured semantics: last successful save). PB-12 N3 is the input only; user-facing wording remains owned by A-12.

potentialLoss.description: What may be lost (at most in-flight transactions / unsaved edits).

recoveryCopy.description: Whether a separate recovery copy is offered.
